propositions: AST gate must detect and reject six categories of prohibited config/credential reads outside approved seams: ambient env read, helper-shim env read, load_config call, literal-getattr on os.environ, provider-credential read, and configurable adapter default/backend reload.

Env-read detection and helper-shim resolution must reuse gen_env_registry's scan/KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS/matchers by direct import (single source), not duplicate logic; receiver-object aliasing (src = os.environ; src.get(...)) and dynamic env reads must be detected and fail closed.

Approved seams (composition roots and provider-credential boundaries) and owner sets must be derived at runtime from existing registries (_child_env.owned_secret_names, @register decorators, gen_env_registry.scan); newly declared credentials/env spellings lacking owners must fail; path-glob exceptions must be rejected structurally.
Legacy-exception set must cover current below-seam reads to allow offline gate introduction without product-code changes; C3 drains exceptions to empty.

Gate must expose check(root)->list[str] and main(argv)->int contract mirroring check_config_reads.py; must run offline without network/CI, exit 0 on current tree, and be tested with synthetic fixtures for each category and aliasing form.
Self-tests must fail on new bypassES, unowned credential names, path-glob exceptions, and missing rationales; clean approved fixtures must pass with no findings.
